_doc: LZ source geometry, schema v1. This file is independent from the runtime tracking geometry. It contains source objects used by the source-flux generator. transport_source controls source-side propagation only: KN = simplified photon transport in the source object, transparent = source carrier only with no self-shielding or scattering. Transparent virtual sources are typically filled with Vacuum on purpose.
name: LZ_source_geometry

sources._doc: TPC PTFE walls source. Real PTFE source and KN source-side transport. Source z extends through the full FC envelope (drift + RFR, z=[-13.75, 145.6]) — wider than the tracking FC_PTFE (drift only) on purpose, so RFR-emitted gammas are sampled and source-side KN self-shielding handles their long grazing paths. wall_thickness 1.147 cm back-derived from bb0nu 184 kg / (rho_PTFE x 2pi x R x H) so geometric mass matches the measured PTFE total.

sources._doc: Upper-conduit TPC PMT cables, COLD segment only. Per LZ TDR section 3.4.4 (line 4763), each upper cable is 12.8 m long with ~8 m of warm routing outside the cryostat -> 4.8 m of cold cable inside. Per-conduit cable counts (LZ TDR Table 3.4.1): 506 upper, 482 lower. Cold cable-meters: 506x4.8=2429 upper, 482x10.6=5109 lower; cold fraction of total = 7538/12068 = 0.625. Of the 88.7 kg total cable mass in LZ paper Table I, the cold portion is ~55.4 kg, of which 17.9 kg (32.2%) is in the upper routing. Warm cables outside the cryostat are not modelled (they sit in the unmodelled MARS region and would be heavily attenuated by the cryostat walls + OD anyway). Virtual transparent cylinder, R=10 cm, z range [154, 189] in AirDome above PMT_TOP_structure.
sources.name: PMT_TOP_cables

sources._doc: Lower-conduit TPC PMT cables, COLD segment only. Per LZ TDR section 3.4.4 (line 4763), each lower cable is 11.6 m long with ~1 m of warm routing -> 10.6 m of cold cable inside the cryostat. Lower routing contains 67.8% of the cold cable-meters (5109/7538), so 37.5 kg of the 55.4 kg total cold mass. Cables exit through a 4-inch bellows at the central port at the bottom of the ICV (LZ paper line 558). Virtual transparent cylinder, R=10 cm, z range [-68, -17] spanning LXe_below_FC and LXe_dome; at r=10 cm the dome bottom is z=-68.50.
sources.name: PMT_BOT_cables

sources._doc: Top-Skin 93 R8520 1-inch PMTs. Per LZ paper arXiv:1910.09124v2 section 2.2, these PMTs are housed in PTFE structures attached to the external side of the field cage, located just below the LXe surface, viewing downward into the side Skin. Modelled as a narrow cylindrical-shell ring at R=74.224 cm (just outside the FC outer wall at 74.224) and z=144 cm (1.6 cm below the LXe surface at 145.6). Previously named PMT_BARREL_R8520 with a full-barrel z extent and R=81.4 cm; both were wrong relative to the published LZ geometry.
sources.name: PMT_SKIN_UPPER_RING

sources._doc: Lower-ring Bottom-Skin R8778 PMTs. 20 PMTs mounted on a ring structure attached to the inner cryostat vessel (ICV) at R=81.4 cm, at the bottom of the side Skin region just above the dome curvature. Per LZ paper arXiv:1910.09124v2 section 2.2: 'At the bottom of the detector a ring structure attached to the vessel contains a further 20 2-inch Hamamatsu R8778 PMTs viewing upward into this lateral region'. Modelled as a narrow 3-cm cylindrical-shell ring centred at z=-12 cm (range z in [-13.5, -10.5]), just above the bottom of the Skin region (z=-13.75).
sources.name: PMT_SKIN_LOWER_RING
